title: Lovable’s valuation doubles to $13.3BN as raises new funds
blurb: Lovable raised $400M in a Series C at a $13.3B valuation, more than double the $6.6B it was worth in December 2025, co-led by Menlo Ventures and EQT's €5B Scaleup Europe Fund. The Stockholm-based vibe-coding startup, whose apps draw over 900M monthly visits, will grow headcount 50% to 450 while facing competition from Replit and potential encroachment from Anthropic and OpenAI.

title: Over 2,500 Organizations Impacted by LiteLLM Supply Chain Attack
blurb: CloudSEK reports that the LiteLLM supply chain attack exposed over 434,000 CI/CD pipelines and impacted more than 2,500 organizations, including Nvidia, AWS, Samsung, and the London Stock Exchange Group. LiteLLM was never targeted directly; its CI pipeline automatically installed a compromised version of Trivy, which pushed two malicious LiteLLM builds to PyPI that ran on every Python invocation and harvested cloud keys, tokens, and AI provider secrets during a 40-minute window.

title: Lovable’s valuation doubles to $13.3BN as raises new funds
blurb: Lovable raised $400M at a $13.3BN valuation, more than double the $6.6BN it carried in December 2025, in a Series C co-led by Menlo Ventures and the EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund. The Stockholm vibe-coding startup now sees over 900M monthly visits to apps built on its platform and is growing headcount 50% to 450. The tell is in the roadmap: Lovable says it will keep routing work across multiple models and post-training open-source ones, a hedge against token costs paid to the same labs that could soon compete with it in app creation.

title: Repeat founder Ryan Williams raises $10M seed for an AI startup for private credit managers
blurb: Ellis AI emerged from stealth with $10M in seed funding to point AI agents at the back-office mess private credit managers live in: scattered documents, spreadsheets, and correspondence that turn Excel into the operating system. Founder Ryan Williams previously co-built Cadre, which peaked at an $800M valuation before selling to Yieldstreet in 2024, and he's betting the next constraint in private markets is operating infrastructure, not the front end. The system connects to a firm's existing tools to monitor portfolios, flag discrepancies, and close the books, while keeping material decisions with human experts.

title: Over 2,500 Organizations Impacted by LiteLLM Supply Chain Attack
blurb: A supply chain attack on the LiteLLM Python library exposed an estimated 434,000 CI/CD pipelines and over 2,500 organizations, including Nvidia, AWS, and the London Stock Exchange Group, after two malicious versions reached PyPI. LiteLLM was compromised indirectly when its CI pipeline auto-installed a poisoned Trivy build, and although the tainted packages were live for only 40 minutes, the payload ran on every Python invocation and leaked cloud keys, SSH keys, and tokens.

title: Over 2,500 Organizations Impacted by LiteLLM Supply Chain Attack
blurb: The LiteLLM supply chain attack exposed over 434,000 CI/CD pipelines across 2,500-plus organizations, including Nvidia, AWS, Samsung, and Cisco, after malicious versions 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 reached PyPI via a compromised Trivy build token, per CloudSEK. The packages ran code on every Python invocation without an import and, though live only 40 minutes, leaked cloud keys, SSH keys, tokens, and AI provider secrets.

title: Cisco Patches Firewall Zero-Day Exploited for DoS Attacks
blurb: Cisco patched CVE-2026-20349, a zero-day in Secure Firewall ASA and FTD software that lets a remote, unauthenticated attacker crash appliances into a DoS condition via a crafted HTTP request to the Remote Access SSL VPN service. Cisco confirmed active exploitation in August, and CISA added the flaw to its KEV catalog with a federal patch deadline of August 14.

title: Kubeflow unveils new cloud native innovations to supercharge AI
blurb: Kubeflow shipped a batch of updates at KubeCon Japan 2026 as it pushes toward CNCF graduation, including the Kale 2.0 pipeline engine, a redesigned CRD-driven Notebooks v2 alpha, and a new Trainer positioned for distributed AI and HPC workloads on Kubernetes. The releases target platform teams running production ML, giving them templated control over notebook environments and a unified SDK for building end-to-end training pipelines.

title: Repeat founder Ryan Williams raises $10M seed for an AI startup for private credit managers
blurb: Ellis AI emerged from stealth with $10M in seed funding, led by investors including First Round Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Thrive Capital, to build AI agents that centralize the fragmented document, spreadsheet, and accounting workflows private credit managers run through Excel. Founded by Cadre co-creator Ryan Williams, the platform connects to a firm's existing systems to flag data discrepancies and automate portfolio monitoring, reporting, and month-end close while keeping human experts on material decisions.
